<security_assessment>
<decision>SAFE</decision>
<details>
The PKGBUILD defines standard packaging variables such as `pkgname`, `pkgver`, `depends`, and `source`, along with a checksum via `sha256sums`. These are all static declarations and pose no risk when sourcing the file for `makepkg --printsrcinfo`. The only function defined at global scope is `_goenv()`, which sets Go-related environment variables. However, this function is not invoked at the top level—it is only called later within the `prepare()` and `build()` functions, which are not executed during `--printsrcinfo`.

There are no command substitutions, dynamic variable assignments, or code execution attempts in the global scope. The `source` array uses a predictable GitHub archive URL based on the tagged version, and the hash is pinned. No network operations or file modifications occur during sourcing. Since only variable definitions and a function *definition* (not execution) are present at the top level, sourcing this PKGBUILD for metadata extraction is safe.

This assessment is limited to the scope of `makepkg --printsrcinfo` and confirms no immediate execution of malicious code during parse time.
</details>
<evidence>

</evidence>
<summary>
No active code in global scope; safe to parse.
</summary>
</security_assessment>

<details>
The PKGBUILD file defines a standard Arch Linux package build process for `herakleo`, a desktop IPTV player. It fetches a specific tagged release from the project's official GitHub repository using a fixed version and includes a valid SHA-256 checksum for verification. The build process is transparent and follows typical practices for Go and frontend JavaScript tooling (using `go mod download`, `bun install`, and `bun run build:wails`).

Dependencies are limited to common GUI and runtime libraries (GTK4, WebKitGTK, GLib, etc.), with optional video player integrations listed as `optdepends`. The `prepare()` and `build()` functions set up the Go and Bun environments safely, with no use of `eval`, obfuscated code, or unauthorized network requests. The `_goenv` function configures standard Go build flags, including disabling version control integration and enabling reproducible builds.

The `package()` function installs only the compiled binary, license, desktop file, AppStream metadata, and icons—none of which involve system-wide modifications or suspicious operations. There are no post-install scripts, systemd services, or PAM configurations that could alter system behavior unexpectedly. All operations are confined to building and installing the application in standard user-accessible locations.
</details>

This file references the legitimate upstream source at `https://github.com/crstian19/herakleo`, specifically the tagged release `v0.1.1`. This checksum ensures the integrity of the downloaded source, and there is no indication of tampering or obfuscation.

All listed dependencies and options are consistent with a typical desktop application built using Go and frontend tools (e.g., `bun`, `nodejs`). The package depends on standard GUI and system libraries (`gtk4`, `webkitgtk-6.0`, `glib2`), which aligns with its description as a desktop IPTV player. No suspicious or unexpected network operations, file modifications, or execution behaviors are present in this metadata file.
</details>
